The dashboard collects sensor values from all of the engines. The backend AI then processes these sensor values to predict the remaining useful life of each engine.

In the following image, the 10 (out of 100) engines most nearing their end-of-life are ordered from most urgent (left) to least urgent (right). The y-axis predicts the remaining life; the lower the more urgent to replace this engine. Red labelled engines are critical/urgent. Blue labelled engines can wait after the red labelled engines have been serviced.

Engines 19 and 91 have been marked as critically urgent to maintain/replace.

Do you trust the AI's prediction?
Trust means: are you confident that the AI’s decisions are accurate and correct.
